title: Transactions by minors prohibited.
bodyText: A dealer shall not receive or purchase any article from any person under the age of eighteen.
bodyHtml: §486M-3  Transactions by minors prohibited.  A dealer shall not receive or purchase any article from any person under the age of eighteen. [L 1982, c 282, pt of §2; am L 1991, c 120, pt of §1]
